title: Atlas claim-to-leaf lookup, v1
description: Which leaf of one map and hierarchy holds a claim the viewer can read, in that map's latest served run: enough for the client to fetch the leaf (<level_url><hierarchy>/<level_id>) and its breadcrumb chain. Asked as <data-atlas-claim-leaf-url><map key>/<hierarchy>/<claim id>. A claim the viewer cannot read, a claim on no leaf of the map, a map the viewer is not a member of and a run something left are one not-found answer. Rules a schema cannot express (the map and hierarchy are the ones asked for, the claim is the one asked for) are checked by epigraph_atlas_contract::check::check_claim_leaf_body and the Explorer's tests/common/atlas_claim_leaf.rs.

kernel_not_found.description: The kernel's one answer for every refusal: no leaf, no hint which case it was.

bff_not_found.description: The Explorer BFF's answer for the same cases.

message.const: We could not find that claim on this map.
